note: Family-run RV campground since 1926 on Long Lake near North Manchester; not a membership park. RVs and campers only: a tent only alongside an RV in your group. Calls itself conservative and Christian; quiet alcohol at your own site only. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $40 ($45 holidays), not membership. Added $15 reservation fee, phone booking, dump, store; cleared sewer (seasonal only). Note's $38 and May 15-Sept 1 are contradicted, removed. Lean: mostly seasonal, flagged.
flags: LONG-STAY, ON THE FENCE (AWH 2026-10-31 rule), I read it as mostly seasonal. No site list exists ('We do not have typical site numbers'), so the nightly share cannot be counted. What the operator leads with: 'We offer seasonal, monthly, and daily camping options'; rates: daily $40, monthly $700, seasonal $1,800, full-hookup seasonal $2,000; the rules page has a long seasonal section (leases, decks, sheds). Of the 10 testimonials on its home page, 9 are signed 'Campground Resident(s)' and 1 'Daily Camper'; one reads 'My folks pulled a trailer onto Lot #2 in 1955 and we haven't budged since'. Imagery: about 120 units, most in tight rows that look long-parked, plus an open lawn near the store with a handful of RVs that may be the daily area (unconfirmed). Against dropping: a posted nightly rate, reservations taken, 'Most non-holiday weekends full up to one month in advance', and Google reviews from short-stay visitors. Test 2 passes. Test 4 not measured.

GATE FACTS: posted $40 ($45 three holidays), operator, read 2026-10-31. Plus $15 per reservation (once per stay, not counted). No gateway within 40 km (Indiana Dunes NP 125 km). Family has not stayed. Presence: working site + phone 765-404-2556. Not in the Good Sam fields. Not a membership park: public rates, family-owned since 1926.

GOOGLE: 4.7 stars, 119 reviews; the newest read fine. 5 stars, 4 months ago: 'Wonderful place for the whole family! All campers are friendly... There is a lot of campers there but still very quiet and roomy'. I read only 5.

WATER, re-audit lead: stored lakefront vs old note's 'adjacent'. Imagery at z18: a row of about 12 RVs along the south shore sits roughly 30-50 m from the water, with docks in front, and the operator lists lake swimming, a slide and fishing. But with no site numbers nothing shows a DAILY camper gets those shore spots, and they look long-parked; the open lawn is about 100 m+ back. If the shore row is seasonal, daily campers get lakeview at best.
PIN: 40.98646,-85.83779 falls on the lawn in the middle of the campground, fine. (A location check: lake is south of it.)

NOTE: stored note said 'public nightly $38' and 'Open ~May 15-Sept 1'; the rates page says $40 and that water runs mid-April to end of October. 'full hookups' applied only to seasonal sites. Stored inclusion_evidence also carries $38.
